messages:
juniper (product): quick design review — dropping two Figma frames: compact rows + row-level download, and dense toolbar with a single download CTA. question: which should be default for org view vs project view? also added a token-denom toggle mock. https://figma.com/file/abc123 (img)
omar (design): looking. first pass: org view is usually summary-focused so toolbar CTA makes sense; project view people expect per-line actions. but compact rows lose affordance for the download icon. thinking tradeoffs: discoverability vs visual density.
juniper (product): exact. also accessibility concern about tiny download icons when we go compact.
kai (frontend): fwiw, row-level CTAs + per-row sparkline + token breakdown is heavy. on initial load we render ~200 rows for big orgs. need virtualization + lazy hydrate for icons. suggested snippet:
```
// virtualize list
<VirtList items={rows} overscan={5}>
  {row => <Row lazyHydrate>{/* actions */}</Row>}
</VirtList>
```
that lets us keep compact rows but only attach listeners when visible.
tess (a11y): small icon-only buttons are hard for keyboard/voiceover. if we keep row-level download, make it text+icon in focus state and add aria-label and aria-describedby that reads invoice month + amount. example: `aria-label="Download invoice for March 2026, $3,241"` Also contrast on token chips — low contrast right now.
omar (design): good call. alternative: keep icon-only visually but expand into "Download" on focus (accessibility reveal). microcopy: change "Download" to "Download invoice" to be explicit for screen readers.
maria (eng): adding row-level download means new API calls when users click many quick downloads, but that's fine. bigger concern: telemetry and rate-limits — we need a debounce on bulk downloads and a server-side throttle. also we should wire event: `billing.invoice.download` with scope: org|project, row_id.
sam (data): prototype telemetry (from last week's usability session) — 23% of users used the row download in the mock where it existed, vs 8% when only toolbar CTA was available. small sample but suggests discoverability wins with row-level CTA. attaching short CSV with counts.
billing-bot: invoice_prep_job started for org: redwood-inc, month: 2026-03
juniper (product): thanks — feels like leaning to hybrid: toolbar primary for bulk downloads + visible row-level overflow menu (three dots) that exposes Download. visually compact, discoverable via overflow. Omar can you mock overflow affordance + focus reveal? Kai, does overflow reduce perf hit vs always-rendering download button?
kai (frontend): yes overflow menu is a single per-row lightweight button (no file payload) and only fetches menu contents on open. much cheaper than embedding full download handler. perf win.
tess (a11y): overflow menu must be keyboard reachable and menu items reachable via arrow keys. ensure `role="menu"` semantics and focus trap-free. also ensure screen reader announces number of attachments if invoice has multiple files.
omar (design): will mock: 1) compact rows with overflow menu + aria-expanded state 2) dense toolbar primary download (affects selected rows) 3) token-denom toggle location (I tried top-right under filters). will post frames in ~2 hours.
juniper (product): plan: A/B test for 2 weeks — variant A: toolbar-only (project+org) ; variant B: hybrid (overflow per-row + toolbar). metric: click-through to download, unsuccessful/failed downloads, and task completion in support flow. sam can you own metrics? maria will implement events. tess + omar + kai will triage a11y & perf tasks.
sam (data): got it. will instrument and return cohorts. baseline metric exported as CSV by Friday.
omar (design): small copy tweak: replace "Tokens" label with "Compute tokens (est. cost)" when hover to reduce confusion.
juniper (product): approved. add to rollout doc: `docs/rollouts/2026-03-invoice-cta-ab-test` and set canary to 5% first.
maria (eng): noted. creating PR for telemetry + overflow menu. tagging y'all.
omar (design): posting updated frames now: https://figma.com/file/abc123#frame2 :thumbsup:
juniper (product): perfect — thanks all. follow-ups: (1) omar post final assets (2) maria PR link in thread (3) sam baseline CSV. will sync Fri 10am. :rocket:
